search_bias: evaluation/verifiers; measurement-validity/benchmark-design; terminal-test-informed sign betting and adaptive-sampling validity for paired binary evaluation

public_primary_sources.title: Gaussian-efficient testing by betting on the mean of bounded data
public_primary_sources.used_scope: Event/Doob-martingale design principle: track a terminal rejection event's conditional probability and derive predictable bets; bounded-data GE-betting is martingale-valid and fixed-horizon oriented. Used only as a design template; the matched-pair derivations and simulations below are new worker-local calculations.

public_primary_sources.title: Anytime validity is free: inducing sequential tests
public_primary_sources.authors: Nick W. Koning; Sam van Meer
public_primary_sources.used_scope: For a simple null, a terminal test can be sequentialized by conditional expectation under the null; composite hypotheses require a family of point-null tests and an essential-infimum construction, and the natural family is not unique. Used to separate the exact fixed-discordant simple-sign construction from the fixed-task composite nuisance problem.

public_primary_sources.title: The McNemar test for binary matched-pairs data: mid-p and asymptotic are better than exact conditional
public_primary_sources.authors: Morten W. Fagerland; Stian Lydersen; Petter Laake
public_primary_sources.used_scope: Exact conditional McNemar conditions on the total number of discordant pairs and uses a Binomial(d,1/2) tail; under the standard matched-pair sampling model its Type-I error does not exceed nominal. Used as the classical terminal test definition, not as support for adaptive task selection.

public_primary_sources.title: Inverse Sampling for McNemar's Test
public_primary_sources.used_scope: Sampling until a pre-specified number of discordant pairs fixes the sample size of the exact binomial component, whereas standard sampling leaves discordant count random. Used to motivate the exact fixed-discordant-horizon route and its random total-task cost.

fixed_discordant_exact_rejection_trackin.setup: Index informative observations by discordant count j. Let X_j=1 for candidate-only success and 0 for incumbent-only success. Under the null, conditional on a discordance, P(X_j=1 | past, discordant)=1/2. Let N be a precommitted discordant horizon and k_N=min{k:P(Bin(N,1/2)>=k)<=alpha}.
fixed_discordant_exact_rejection_trackin.predictable_bet: a_j(w)=H_{j+1}(w+1)/[H_{j+1}(w+1)+H_{j+1}(w)] when the denominator is positive; arbitrary (e.g. 1/2) on zero-continuation states. On each task use factor 2a_j on candidate-only discordance, 2(1-a_j) on incumbent-only discordance, and 1 on concordance.
fixed_discordant_exact_rejection_trackin.robust_validity: If task-level discordance probability rho_t is any predictable process and the null satisfies P(+|past)=P(-|past)=rho_t/2, then E[factor_t|past]=(1-rho_t)+rho_t*a_j+rho_t*(1-a_j)=1. Thus concordance waiting times and predictable rho_t do not affect martingale validity.
fixed_discordant_exact_rejection_trackin.terminal_identity: After j discordances, K=H_j/H_0. At N discordances K_N=1/H_0 on the exact-binomial rejection event and 0 otherwise. Since H_0 is the exact terminal size alpha_N<=alpha, every terminal exact rejection crosses the 1/alpha e-threshold; earlier crossing can use discreteness slack while retaining Ville control.
fixed_discordant_exact_rejection_trackin.scope: Exact for a precommitted discordant horizon N and one-sided sign-symmetry null. Total task cost is random. It is not terminal-equivalent to fixed-total-task McNemar where the final discordant count is random.

fixed_task_directional_projection.setup: For fixed total task horizon T, define terminal exact McNemar rejection R_T(d,w)=1{w>=k_d}. Choose a reference null discordance model rho_ref (constant 0.4 in the calculation) and compute H_t^ref(d,w)=P_ref(R_T=1 | current state) by three-branch backward recursion.
fixed_task_directional_projection.projected_bet: Let H_plus=H_{t+1}^ref(d+1,w+1), H_minus=H_{t+1}^ref(d+1,w). Set a_t=H_plus/(H_plus+H_minus), with 1/2 when the denominator is zero, and deliberately discard the nuisance-sensitive concordance continuation ratio by assigning concordance factor 1.
fixed_task_directional_projection.validity: The resulting process is not the reference Doob martingale and need not match the terminal exact McNemar decision. Nevertheless its one-step factor is a valid conditional e-variable for every actual predictable rho_t under sign symmetry, because validity depends only on a_t being predictable and on + and - having equal null probability.
fixed_task_directional_projection.interpretation: This is a nuisance-robust directional projection of terminal rejection geometry: use the reference model only to choose where to bet, while the null expectation identity supplies validity.

adaptive_discordance_counterexample.claim: Classical exact conditional McNemar size control is not implied by one-step sign symmetry alone when future discordance propensity/task selection may adapt to past paired outcomes.
adaptive_discordance_counterexample.dynamic_program: For a fixed total horizon T and terminal exact-McNemar rejection indicator V_T(d,w), maximize under the null over predictable rho_t in [rho_lo,rho_hi]: V_t(d,w)=max_rho[(1-rho)V_{t+1}(d,w)+rho/2*V_{t+1}(d+1,w+1)+rho/2*V_{t+1}(d+1,w)]. The objective is linear in rho, so an endpoint policy is exact.
adaptive_discordance_counterexample.why_conditioning_breaks: When rho_t depends on past signs, the final discordant count D_T is informative about the sign path; conditioning on D_T need not leave W_T~Bin(D_T,1/2), even though each new discordant sign is locally symmetric when it occurs.
adaptive_discordance_counterexample.scope: This does not contradict Fagerland et al.'s standard matched-pair result. It targets adaptive benchmark/task selection or adaptive continuation that makes discordance propensity depend on prior outcomes.

fixed_task_projected_reference_rho_0_4.alternative: iid task stream, rho=0.4, discordant candidate-win probability q=0.75
fixed_task_projected_reference_rho_0_4.interpretation: The projected rejection-tracking bet captures much of the Bellman finite-horizon gain without a wealth-grid optimization: it is within about 1.0/4.7/6.1/4.9 percentage points of the prior Bellman policy at T=10/20/30/50 in this alternative, while strongly beating the prior fixed-GRO, Jeffreys and full-KT baselines at short horizons. It slightly exceeds terminal exact power at T=10 and 20 via early crossing, but falls below terminal exact at T=30 and 50 because the nuisance-robust projection sacrifices terminal equivalence.

adaptive_terminal_mcnemar_exact_type1_ma.null_constraint: At each task P(+|past)=P(-|past)=rho_t/2; rho_t may be chosen predictably from current state.
adaptive_terminal_mcnemar_exact_type1_ma.interpretation: With rho_t constrained to [0.1,0.7], exact terminal McNemar can reach Type-I rejection probabilities about 0.0601, 0.0746 and 0.0889 at T=20,30,50, exceeding nominal 0.05. With unrestricted [0,1], maxima rise to about 0.0987,0.1295,0.1579. Thus local sign symmetry is insufficient for the usual fixed-task exact conditional argument when discordance sampling is outcome-adaptive.

sanity_mc_against_rho_0_1_to_0_7_adversa.note: Projected e-process remains theoretically <=0.05 for any such predictable rho policy by the one-step martingale identity; Monte Carlo is only a sanity check.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Sequentialize a terminal exact binomial/McNemar sign test at a precommitted discordant horizon by betting the normalized conditional terminal rejection probability; concordant tasks receive factor 1.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Closed-form continuation H_j(w) yields an exact Doob sign bet. Exact DP at alpha=.05,q=.75 gives reject-by-N 0.3782/0.6922/0.8943/0.9760 for N=10/20/30/50 discordances versus terminal exact power 0.2440/0.6172/0.8943/0.9713, with null sequential sizes 0.0391/0.0414/0.04938/0.04413. Predictable task-specific discordance rates cancel from the one-step null expectation.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: One-sided sign symmetry, fixed discordant horizon; random total task cost. Does not solve fixed-total-task terminal equivalence.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.implication: When task budget can be expressed as a target number of informative disagreements, inverse-sample discordances and use rejection-tracking sign betting rather than repeatedly peeking at a fixed-sample exact test.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: For fixed total task horizons with nuisance discordance rate, compute terminal rejection continuation values under a reference rho model but use only their + versus - directional ratio as a predictable sign bet, assigning concordances factor 1.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: At rho_ref=actual rho=.4,q=.75 and alpha=.05, 600k-rep Monte Carlo gives projected reject-by-T 0.0874/0.2797/0.4169/0.6508 for T=10/20/30/50. Prior Bellman values were 0.0970/0.3266/0.4781/0.6996; prior fixed-GRO 0.00123/0.0758/0.2438/0.5388; prior Jeffreys 0.00731/0.1044/0.1799/0.3331. Validity is exact under arbitrary predictable rho_t as long as conditional + and - probabilities match.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: The rho_ref calculation is a design heuristic, not a null model required for validity. The projected process is not terminal-equivalent to fixed-task McNemar and its power can degrade under reference mismatch.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.implication: A cheap terminal-geometry-informed policy can recover much of finite-horizon Bellman power while retaining nuisance-robust validity and avoiding online wealth-grid optimization.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Treat adaptive task/benchmark selection that changes discordance propensity based on past paired outcomes as a measurement-validity hazard: final discordant count becomes informative, invalidating the usual conditional Binomial(D,1/2) argument even under local sign symmetry.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Exact control DP over predictable rho_t shows terminal exact McNemar Type-I maxima above 0.05: with rho_t in [0.1,0.7], 0.0601/0.0746/0.0889 at T=20/30/50; with rho_t in [0,1], 0.0987/0.1295/0.1579. The sign-betting e-process remains valid because each factor has conditional expectation exactly 1 for every predictable rho_t.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: Counterexample applies to adaptive discordance/task-selection processes. It does not challenge the standard i.i.d./fixed-sampling exact McNemar guarantee.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.implication: If evaluation task allocation, retrying, filtering, or continuation is outcome-adaptive, either precommit an independent sampling design or use an e-process whose validity is conditional on the actual adaptive filtration; do not rely on post-hoc exact McNemar conditioning alone.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: The exact McNemar test remains exact under any adaptive task stream as long as each new discordant sign is locally fair under the null.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected. Local sign symmetry does not imply W_T|D_T~Bin(D_T,1/2) when future discordance probability depends on past signs. Exact DP yields Type-I error well above 0.05 under bounded predictable rho policies.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: Terminal rejection-probability tracking under one reference discordance rate is automatically the exact Doob martingale for fixed-total-task McNemar.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected. The exact Doob update contains a concordance continuation component that depends on the nuisance discordance model. Dropping that component preserves sign-martingale validity but loses terminal equivalence.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: Inverse sampling to a fixed discordant count solves evaluation cost.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected as a general claim. It fixes the informative sign horizon and yields clean exact sequentialization, but total tasks become random and can be prohibitive when discordance is rare.

design_implications.gate_1: Declare whether the evaluation horizon is total tasks or informative discordances. These induce different exact objects and cost semantics.
design_implications.gate_2: If task selection/continuation can depend on prior paired outcomes, test whether final discordant count remains ancillary/ignorable. If not, classical terminal McNemar conditioning is unsafe.
design_implications.gate_3: For robust adaptive evaluation, prefer predictable sign e-factors whose conditional expectation can be verified in the actual filtration; use terminal models only to choose bets, not to justify validity, unless the nuisance model is genuinely fixed.
design_implications.gate_4: Report both terminal-test power and reject-by-deadline power. Rejection-tracking can exploit exact-test discreteness slack early, but nuisance-robust projections may sacrifice terminal equivalence.
design_implications.gate_5: When using a reference-model projected bet, stress-test rho schedule mismatch and adaptive task-selection policies separately from sign-effect q uncertainty.

frontier_queue.action: Optimize or mix the reference discordance model used by the fixed-task directional rejection-projection, while preserving sign-only validity; compare learned/predictable rho_ref, rho-mixtures, and Bellman policies under common, increasing, decreasing, and outcome-adaptive discordance schedules.

Derive a two-sided exact-McNemar rejection-tracking construction, including boundary randomization to use discreteness slack without losing finite-sample validity, and compare separate-tail/mixture/maximum combinations.

Quantify total-task cost and futility rules for fixed-discordant inverse sampling under low or drifting discordance rates; derive an anytime-valid fallback when the target discordant count is not reached by a hard total-task cap.

Search for published selective/adaptive paired-testing results that characterize when conditioning on an adaptively generated discordant count remains valid; compare their assumptions directly with the DP counterexample.

early_termination_avoidance: The previous terminal-rejection-tracking frontier was not merely restated: it yielded an exact fixed-discordant Doob sign construction, a nuisance-robust fixed-task directional projection, and a new exact counterexample showing that terminal conditional McNemar can lose size control under outcome-adaptive discordance sampling.
exact_next_action: Stress-test and optimize the fixed-task directional rejection-projection over reference-rho mixtures/predictable estimates under varying and outcome-adaptive discordance schedules, then derive the two-sided/boundary-randomized version while retaining exact sign-martingale validity.
